nodes.label: Action Manifest Pattern (Single Source of Truth for Actions)
nodes.rationale: Introduced to eliminate cross-runtime string parity fragility between Python and Unity. Before this, action names, parameters, required_capabilities, and engine command types lived in three separate locations with no enforced consistency — a typo between Python and Unity produced a silent failure. YAML chosen for human readability; JSON sidecar generated for Unity because Unity has no built-in YAML parser for arbitrary files. Handler class paths intentionally excluded from the manifest to avoid coupling it to Python class paths.

nodes.label: ActionManifestValidator (Unity Editor Menu Item)
nodes.rationale: Discovers action names by reflecting on the static HandledActions field — a convention used by all built-in handlers. Reflection approach chosen over attribute-based ([BiomataHandles('patrol')]) because the convention already works for all four built-in handlers without code changes; attribute approach deemed unnecessary abstraction for a one-time editor check. Warns (not errors) on unhandled actions because a shared manifest may declare actions not all projects implement.

hyperedges.label: Action Manifest Pipeline: YAML → Python → JSON → Unity
